Independent uniform priorities couple K_j-neighbour selection with Bernoulli(U_j) columns, differing in O_p(n^{3/2}) edges, hence fixed motif densities and cut convergence to W where the younger vertex supplies its propensity. Exact likelihood ratio gives scalar Mahonian rate -I(rho) (acknowledged prior).
